invariants.note: Single SWAP kernel unaffected; runtime/coupler-only addition.
No file, format, path, parsing or file-unit dependency introduced.
Physical parameters/state/forcing/numerical policy remain separate.
No new persistent per-column physical state introduced.
No solver scratch moved into persistent column state.
No storage-layout constraint added; batching/SoA remain possible.
Rejected interface exchange is never booked; only explicit commit updates the ledger.
Repeated trials remain based on explicit committed/checkpoint origin.
Generic [t0,t1] semantics retained; no calendar unit assumption.
No fixed coupling-window duration or midnight boundary introduced.
Groundwater coupling is represented explicitly at runtime/coupler level.
Ledger uses the F-GC17 sign convention and derives groundwater exchange as exact negative of SWAP exchange.
One canonical signed exchange quantity drives both sides; there is no interface mass tolerance.
Interface-sensitivity output path remains available and unmodified.
No structural multiplication of full SWAP trajectories introduced.
MultiSWAP batching/runtime ownership remains compatible.
No 1:1 SWAP-column to groundwater-cell assumption introduced.
Deep-vadose remains a separate optional external component.
No transition storage is created or destroyed by this change.
Soil-water solver abstraction remains open to alternatives.
Shared SWAP process physics remain untouched.
No new dependency on HeadCalc internals introduced.
Physical options and numerical/coupling policy remain distinct.
No unbounded retry or hidden fallback path introduced.
Reference mode remains available and unchanged.
Per-window and cumulative exchange quantities plus commit/reject state are explicit.
Optional capability incurs cost only when invoked.
System composition remains runtime/coupler-owned.
No silent midnight, daily, file-format or external-model dependency.
Change explicitly audited against all architecture invariants.
